name: agile-scrum
title: Agile (Scrum) overlay
summary: Backlog, then sprints of design, build and review with persona agents; fits evolving products where direction changes.

stages.name: backlog
stages.goal: Write the PRD and a prioritised backlog of stories.
stages.exit: The user orders the backlog and picks the first sprint's stories.
stages.skip_when: The user brings a ready backlog.

stages.name: sprint-design
stages.goal: Clickthrough of the sprint's screens and flows.
stages.exit: The user clicks through and accepts the flows.
stages.skip_when: The sprint has no UI change.

stages.name: sprint-build
stages.goal: Build the sprint's stories as verified features.

stages.name: sprint-review
stages.goal: Demo the increment and decide: next sprint, change direction or release.
stages.exit: The user picks the next sprint's stories, a direction change, or release.

stages.name: release
stages.goal: Reflect on the output and hand over.
stages.exit: Output reflection decides pass or human-review.
